title: Private Party Bus Experience in Nashville (up to 35 guests)
includes: 2 Hour Private Party Bus Experience in Nashville
Experience Nashville in a truly unique way
Ticket Price includes 24 hour or greater Trip Insurance Fee of $59.99
Cooler with ice and cups provided
Private Party Bus can hold up to 35 guests
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Our tours operate rain or shine, hot or cold. Please dress for the weather!
Food is not allowed on the bus.
Our bartender/dj will reach out to you via text message the day prior to your tour to introduce him/herself. We make that contact between 4 and 9PM CST.
If you want to have any alcohol on board, everyone must be 21. If you have people under 21, there can be no alcohol on board.
Per city guidelines, our party bus no longer BYOB. Alcohol must be purchased through our partner bar, The Green Light. Information will be sent to you via email.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Nobody knows how to throw a party like Joyride. Hop on our bus and let the good times roll! The party bus is our version of Tin Roof - One of Nashville's best bars and or our pretty pink bus with a unique and fun atmosphere. Hope aboard a have your own party! Our buses hold up to 35 of your closest friends. 

Per city guidelines, our party bus no longer BYOB. Alcohol must be purchased through our partner bar, The Green Light. Information will be sent to you via email.

Our bartender/dj will reach out to you via text message the day prior to your tour to introduce him/herself. We make that contact between 4 and 9PM CST.
